profile_text.body:
UC Berkeley's vLLM team maintains an open-source high-throughput inference engine for large language models. vLLM is self-hosted and designed to avoid external data sharing. The project is hosted on GitHub alongside millions of other developer projects and open source communities.

The vLLM project is categorized as an open source, self-hosted model offering. As a university lab initiative rather than a for-profit enterprise, it operates within Berkeley's research infrastructure and has been verified as of September 10, 2026.
